name: Conformidad de Género Textual
mechanism:
This method analyzes genre conformity for AI text detection following Uchendu et al. (2020):

1. **Genre Clasificación**: The text is classified into its genre/domain (academic, journalistic, conversational, creative fiction, technical documentation, social media, etc.) using stylistic and structural features — sentence length distributions, vocabulary complexity, formality markers, and discourse structure.

2. **Genre - Specific Feature Extracción**: Features specific to the detected genre are extracted. Each genre has distinct characteristics: academic writing uses passive voice, hedging language, and citation patterns; journalism uses inverted pyramid structure and attribution; creative writing uses figurative language and varied sentence rhythm.

3. **Conformity Evaluación**: The text's adherence to genre conventions is measured. Human writers naturally conform to genre expectations through learned writing conventions and audience awareness. AI-generated text may show: (a) genre mixing (formal vocabulary with informal structure), (b) surface-level genre markers without deep genre understanding, (c) generic language that fits no specific genre.

4. **Estadístico Genre Perfil Comparación**: The text's statistical profile (word frequency distributions, part-of-speech patterns, syntactic complexity metrics) is compared against reference profiles for the detected genre. Deviations from expected genre statistics — particularly in higher-order features like discourse coherence and rhetorical structure — indicate potential AI generation.

5. **Genre Conformity Puntuación**: A conformity score is computed measuring how well the text matches its expected genre profile. The score considers multiple dimensions: lexical conformity, syntactic conformity, structural conformity, and pragmatic conformity. Low overall conformity or inconsistent conformity across dimensions suggests AI generation.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: estadística
Medio: texto
Entrada: Raw texto string
Minimum texto length: 100 characters
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Procesamiento: Client-side NLP analysis
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 65-85% precisión independiente. Performance increases significantly when combined with complementary texto analysis methods. Results vary with texto length, language, and content type.
source: Statistical NLP analysis methods for AI-generated texto detection. Based on computational linguistics and information theory research.
useCase: Detección de texto generado por IA mediante análisis de conformidad de género. Este método examina patrones lingüísticos específicos que difieren entre texto escrito por humanos y texto generado por IA, proporcionando evidencia complementaria en un pipeline de análisis multi-método.
strengths:
• Fast client-side analysis with no server required
• Effective as part of a multi-method analysis pipeline
• Works across various texto types and genres
• Based on established linguistic research
• Complements other estadística texto analysis methods
limitations:
• Mejor utilizado en combinación con otros métodos de análisis de texto
• El rendimiento varía con la longitud del texto (requiere texto suficiente)
• Puede verse afectado por el idioma y estilo de escritura del texto
• La precisión depende del modelo de IA utilizado para la generación
• La escritura humana puede ocasionalmente generar falsos positivos

references.title: Uchendu, A. et al. (2020). Authorship Attribution for Neural Text Generation. EMNLP.
Jawahar, G. et al. (2020). Automatic Detection of Machine Generated Text: A Critical Survey. COLING.
